definitions.explanation: One of the three basic states of matter, in which a substance maintains a fixed shape and volume. Contrasts with liquid and gas.

examples.english: Ice is the solid form of water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{物質|ぶっしつ}→物質：03608_busshitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{固体|こたい}、⟦{液体|えきたい}→液体：04134_ekitai⟧、⟦{気体|きたい}→気体：02632_kitai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧3つ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}けられる→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧。
examples.english: The states of matter are divided into three: solid, liquid, and gas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{液体|えきたい}→液体：04134_ekitai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{固体|こたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{凝固|ぎょうこ}→凝固：08668_gyouko⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧。
examples.english: When the temperature drops, a liquid changes into a solid. This change is called solidification.

notes:
USAGE:
{固体|こたい} is a scientific term used in physics, chemistry, and everyday language when discussing states of matter.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{液体|えきたい}→液体：04134_ekitai⟧ (liquid)
- ⟦{気体|きたい}→気体：02632_kitai⟧ (gas)
- {固体|こたい}・⟦{液体|えきたい}→液体：04134_ekitai⟧・⟦{気体|きたい}→気体：02632_kitai⟧ is the standard order when listing the three states

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{個体|こたい}→個体：04028_kotai⟧ (same reading, different kanji) means an individual organism — do not confuse

- {固体|こたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ (solid state)
